referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory for 1 MJ heat from diesel, burned in a cogeneration unit with a capacity of 300 kWth. The multioutput process "diesel, burned in cogen 300kWth delivers the coproducts "heat, at cogen 300kWth, diesel, allocation exergy" and "electricity, at cogen 300kWth, diesel, allocation exergy". The energy efficiency is 39% for electricity and 47% for heat. The exergy factor is 1 for ectricity and 0.164 for heat. This leads to the allocation factor of 0.83 for electricity an 0.17 for heat.; UUID: c6d2f972-2b73-3449-9242-e801a8b7d1cf
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the diesel burning in a 300 kWth cogen unit which in turn includes fuel input, infrastructure (boiler), air and water emissions and electrictiy needed for operation. The efficiency and allocation according to exergy is considered
